abstract_evidence_excerpt: The mechanism of reaction of FeFe hydrogenases with oxygen has been debated. We show that the two most studied FeFe hydrogenases, from Chlamydomonas reinhardtii and Clostridium acetobutylicum, react with O2 according to the same mechanism, despite the fact that the former is much more O2 sensitive than the latter.
